abstract: Looking at each measure, the groups differ in these ways. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Alvenor.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Alvenor. Overall, Brostamide lowers blood pressure control compared with Alvenor.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Willow Lane Cohort.
